summary: Runs one action when activated, or submits or resets the form it belongs to.

variant.description: neutral is a raised key; primary is the one filled action of a view; ghost is a bare label or icon with no face, its box its content, for a control a row, a toolbar or a trail already shapes.

type.description: What activation does to the form: nothing, submit it, or reset it.

value.description: Submitted with the button's name when this button submits the form.

name.description: The name the value is submitted under.

disabled.description: The button cannot be activated or focused.

root.note: primary: face solid; ghost: no part, the host is its shape (hosted control)

submit.note: A hidden native submit button (D19). It makes this button the form's default button and its submitter.

events.click: Dispatched once per activation: pointer, Enter, Space, or Enter in a text field when this is the form's submit button.

notYet: The `form` attribute, to submit a form the button is not inside.
